design: Lean mature archivist with a sharply sloped long skull, slim closed four mandibles and extremely long white-tipped dreadlocks tied into one low rope braid. Narrow black scholar coat with sleeveless ivory overdrape, asymmetrical skirt hem, twin small square belt cases. Opens a compact bifold bronze slate with both hands at chest height. Off-white mottled hide, subtly side-on right-facing stance.
